thread:
Morgan: kicking off POC with EdgeFrame (regional bank). They need SSO (SAML), SCIM user sync with roles, domain ownership proof, and a pricing delta for Dedicated + Private. Need answers by EOD Wed.
Lina: I'll scope SAML & SCIM. Quick Q: EdgeFrame wants NameID persistent + email attribute. Any custom attribute constraints? Also: what's their expected SCIM delta frequency?
Raj: For RBAC mapping, ask them to send their role schema. We can propose a groups->roles mapping and SCIM group push example. For a POC, simplest is groups-only sync.
Sasha: On Dedicated pricing — rough ballpark for a 2-week POC: reserved pool + burst = $6k, add 24/7 support + compliance review = +$2k. I'll pull firm numbers from finance. :money_with_wings: 
Morgan: Legal attached a security questionnaire from the customer. Key asks: SOC2, KMS/HSM integration, customer data isolation, retention windows, and audit logs. @legal any immediate red flags?
legal: No showstoppers. For Private/on-prem they want fully customer-controlled KMS and audit trails — that's doable but needs deployment-level CLA. We can draft answers; need to know target deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) and retention window to be precise.
infra-bot: preview env created: preview-edgeframe-2024-11-10. TCP allowlist IPs: 52.14.23.15, 3.120.45.62.
Lina: SAML mapping sample (from eng-runtime) — please forward to customer for validation:
```saml
<Attribute Name='email'>user.email</Attribute>
<Attribute Name='roles'>user.groups</Attribute>
<NameID Format='persistent'>user.id</NameID>
```
Raj: SCIM notes: we support full sync + delta upserts, group push for RBAC. Default eventual consistency ~15s for attribute propagation. If they need near-real-time eventing, recommend webhook change hooks via Dedicated/Private. Also confirm whether they use SCIM v2.
Morgan: Action items: 1) Lina send SAML + SCIM samples to EdgeFrame today. 2) Ask EdgeFrame for role schema, SCIM rate, and domain proofing method. 3) Sasha/Finance produce POC quote (dedicated vs private). 4) Legal to draft questionnaire answers. Aim to kickoff POC Friday. @Sasha @Lina @Raj
Sasha: I'll have a draft quote by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Morgan: Thanks — I'll PM EdgeFrame to get their role schema and confirm SCIM cadence.
